metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 50% a year over 5 years, 59% over 3 (accelerating); last 12 months 14%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 35% a year over 5 years, 41% over 3; last 12 months 119%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 122% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Debt
metrics.reading: Borrowings ₹994 cr, 0.21× equity; up from ₹667 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Profit growth over the last 12 months demonstrates strong earnings momentum.
ROCE has improved from 23% in FY22 to 29% in FY26, indicating efficient capital deployment.
Operating cash flow over five years has been 122% of net profit, reflecting high-quality earnings.

bear.point: The company missed its Q2FY26 volume growth target of at least 15% due to a shipment decline.
Multiple operational milestones, including factory readiness and production starts, have been delayed or gone quiet.
Revenue growth has decelerated significantly to 14% over the last 12 months compared to historical averages.
